headline: Approved one-day liquor and entertainment licenses for several events and transferred licenses to Olives Hospitality, 92 Shrewsbury Street.
summary: The commission approved one-day liquor and entertainment licenses for several events, including Pride Worcester, Massachusetts Organization of African Descendents, and Casa Cultural Dominicana Worcester. It approved the transfer of licenses to Olives Hospitality, LLC at 92 Shrewsbury Street. It postponed several applications to August 6, 2026, and placed several items on file.
decisions: Approved the July 9, 2026 minutes, 3-0.
Approved one-day liquor and entertainment licenses for Pride Worcester, 28 Franklin Street, for September 12, 2026, 3-0.
Approved a one-day entertainment license for the Shrewsbury Street Italian Heritage Parade, East Park, for October 11, 2026, 3-0.
Approved a one-day entertainment license for the Green Hill Neighborhood Block Party, Grant Square Park, for August 1, 2026, 3-0.
Approved a one-day liquor license for Ecotarium, 222 Harrington Way, for July 28, 2026, 3-0.
Approved one-day liquor licenses for Richard Perna, 1 College Street, for football events on dates from August 29 through November 21, 2026, 3-0.
Approved one-day liquor and entertainment licenses for the Massachusetts Organization of African Descendents, Worcester Common, for August 1, 2026, 3-0.
Postponed the application for HHS-DYO_Casita Cultura Latina, Institute Park, to August 6, 2026, 3-0.
Approved a one-day liquor license for Cam Brigham, 48 Green Street (outside), for July 24, 2026, 3-0.
Approved a one-day entertainment license for the Hiroshima Commemoration, Elm Park, for August 6, 2026, 3-0.
Approved one-day liquor and entertainment licenses for Casa Cultural Dominicana Worcester, 126 Salisbury Street, for September 5, 2026, 3-0.
Approved an entertainment license for the Brazilian Festival of Worcester, Institute Park, for September 13, 2026, 3-0.
Approved a common victualer license for Quinsigamond Gas & Market, LLC, 75 Quinsigamond Avenue, 3-0.
Approved a common victualer license for Dippin Donuts, 75 Quinsigamond Avenue, 3-0.
Postponed the entertainment license application for Paku Paku, Inc., 215 Chandler Street, to August 6, 2026, 3-0.
Postponed the change of manager application for Italian American World War Veterans of the US Inc. Post 3, 14 Itam Court, to August 6, 2026, 3-0.
Approved the remaining dates for outdoor Sunday live music from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. for Worcester Marine Corps League, 181 Lake Avenue, 3-0.

Approved the transfer of the restaurant all alcohol license from Brick House, LLC dba Nuovo, plus the common victualer and entertainment licenses, for Olives Hospitality, LLC, 92 Shrewsbury Street, 3-0.
Postponed the restaurant all alcohol license application for Grill and Green Kitchen, Inc., 141 Highland Street, to August 6, 2026, 3-0.
Postponed the application for transfer of the restaurant all alcohol license from Suveroo LLC to L&D Enterprises LLC, 5 Saugus Place, to August 6, 2026, 3-0.
Postponed the status hearing for Italian American World War Vets of The US, 14 Itam Court, to August 6, 2026, 3-0.
Filed the status item for Myron Katz, 667 Main Street, on corrections to the lodging house license, 3-0.
Placed on file the email from the Marine Corps League manager resigning the position.
Placed on file the ABCC liquor license quotas communication for the City of Worcester.
Voted 3-0 to bring Victory Bar, 56 Shrewsbury Street, in for a status hearing.

plain_text:
License Commission 
         Meeting Minutes 
   July 23, 2026 
 
 
Attendance: 
 
Commissioners Present: 
 
 
Anthony Vigliotti, Chair 
Charran Fisher, Commissioner 
Maritza Cruz, Commissioner 
 
Commissioners Absent:  
Staff Present: 
 
 
 
Sgt. Thomas Needham, Worcester Police Department  
Amanda Moran, Law Department 
Deborah Steele, Licensing  
 
 
Minutes: July 9, 2026 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3- 0 to approve the July 9, 2026, License Commission 
minutes. 
 
Requests for Continuances, Extensions, Postponements, & Withdrawals 
 
One Day Liquor & Entertainment Requests 
 
1. Pride Worcester, 28 Franklin Street 
Request for one day liquor license 
Request for one day entertainment license for dancing by patrons, tv, live music, 
recorded music 
• Saturday-September 12, 2026- 2:00 p.m.-7:00 p.m. 
 
Ariana Dello Stritto, participating remotely, stated that this is for their annual festival. Alcohol will 
be served by certified bartenders; they have police present  for the event and they will use same 
footprint as previous year. Ms. Dello Stritto stated that there will be road closure and working with 
DPW on that.
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day liquor and entertainment 
licenses. 
 
List of Exhibits:  
 
Exhibit A: Application for one day liquor license received and dated May 5, 2026. 
Exhibit B: Application for one day entertainment license received and dated May 5, 2026. 
 
2. Shrewsbury Street Italian Heritage Parade, East Park 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music, amplification system 
• Sunday-October 11, 2026-1:00 p.m.-4:00 p.m.  
 
Maria Stella Fiore, participating remotely, stated this is request for entertainment for parade. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits: Application for one day entertainment license received and dated July 8, 2026. 
 
3. Green Hill Neighborhood Block Party, Grant Square Park 
Request for one day entertainment license for DJ 
• Saturday August 1, 2026-1:00 p.m.-4:00 p.m. rain date August 2, 2026 
 
Winifred Octave and Councilor Rob Bilotta, participating remotely, on behalf of item.  Ms. Octave 
stated that this is request for DJ that will attend the event at the park. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits: Application for one  day entertainment license received and dated July 7, 2026. 
 
4. Ecotarium, 222 Harrington Way 
Request for one day liquor license 
• Tuesday-July 28, 2026-5:30 p.m.-6:30 p.m. 
 
Alexis Rapport, participating remotely, stated that this a private event and expecting about 50 
people. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one day liquor license. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated July 7, 2026. 
 
5. Richard Perna, 1 College Street 
Request for one day liquor license 
• Saturday-August 29, 2026-2:30 p.m.-7:00 p.m.
• Saturday-September 19, 2026-1:00 p.m.-5:30 p.m. 
• Saturday-October 24, 2026-Noon-4:30 p.m. 
• Saturday-October 31, 2026-Noon-4:30 p.m. 
• Saturday-November 14, 2026-11:00 a.m.-3:30 p.m. 
• Saturday-November 21, 2026-11:00 a.m.-3:30 p.m. 
 
Richard Perna, participating remotely, stated that this for football events and they will have security, 
TIPS certified bartenders. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one day liquor licenses. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated July 9, 2026. 
 
6. Massachusetts Organization of African Descendents, Worcester Common 
Request for one day liquor license 
Request for one day entertainment license for dancing by patrons, dancing by 
entertainers, live music, play, moving picture show  
• Saturday-August 1, 2026-Noon-7:30 p.m. 
 
Jeroma Komorah, participating remotely, stated they are looking for a one day liquor and 
entertainment license and celebrating FIFA. She stated that they are expecting 1,000 to 3,000 
people. She stated that they will have WPD for security. She stated that they will have stanchions for 
beer garden and will have TIPS certified bartenders. 
 
Sgt. Needham asked if the road closure had been applied for. Ms. Kormrah stated that they had 
been. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day liquor and entertainment 
licenses. 
 
List of Exhibits: 
 
Exhibit A:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated July 15, 2026. 
Exhibit B: Application for one  day entertainment license  received and dated July 15, 2025. 
 
7. HHS-DYO_Casita Cultura Latina, Institute Park 
Request for one day liquor license 
Request for one day entertainment license for dancing by patrons, dancing by 
entertainers, live music, amplification system, any other audio or visual show whether 
live or recorded specifically  
• Saturday-October 24, 2026-10:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. rain date November 1, 2026
Anna VR, participating remotely, stated that there will be a designated area for alcohol and food 
vendors. 
 
Chair Vigliotti asked where the alcohol would be purchased and Commission was unfamiliar with the 
vendor. Commissioner Cruz requested application be continued for two weeks as event not until Fall. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to postpone the application to the August 6, 2026. 
 
8. Cam Brigham, 48 Green Street 
Request for one day liquor license (outside) 
• July 24, 2026 -9:00 p.m. – 1:30 a.m. 
 
Cam Brigham, participating remotely, stated that there will be security inside and outside for the 
event and he will also try to obtain a police detail. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one day liquor license. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated July 7, 2026. 
 
9. The Cellular Connection, 68 Stafford Street 
Request for one day entertainment license for dancing by entertainers, recorded 
music, live music, dj 
• Sunday-July 26, 2026-1:00 p.m.-4:00 p.m. 
 
No one appeared for meeting. 
 
10. Hiroshima Commemoration, Elm Park 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music, amplification system 
• Thursday-August 6, 2026-6:00 p.m.-8:30 p.m. 
 
Claire Schaeffer-Duffy, participating remotely, stated that she is looking to apply for one day event 
for this Hiroshima Commemoration event being held at Elm Park. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one-day entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits:  Application for one day entertainment license received and dated July 17, 2026. 
 
11. Casa Cultural Dominicana Worcester, 126 Salisbury Street 
Request for one day liquor license 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music, dancing by entertainers, 
amplification system 
• Saturday-September 5, 2026-11:00 a.m. -7:00 p.m.
Delio Fernandez appeared upon behalf of the application. Mr. Fernadez stated that they will have 
roped off area for alcohol and there will be designated fenced area for the beer. They will have a 
police officer and a security guard to check ID. There will be bathrooms at the park and will also 
being ordering five more porta potties. He stated they expect between 300-500 people. The beer 
garden will not hold more than 25 people at a time. 
 
Sgt. Needham stated Mr. Fernadez may want to work with the police on directing the traffic. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the one day liquor and entertainment 
licenses. 
 
List of Exhibits: 
 
Exhibit A:  Application for one day liquor license received and dated July 15, 2026. 
Exhibit B:  Application for one  day entertainment license received and dated July 15, 2026. 
 
12. Royal Ladies Garden Party, Institute Park 
Request for one day entertainment license for recorded music, DJ 
• Sunday-August 2, 2026-2:00 p.m. – 7:00 p.m. 
 
No one appeared for meeting. 
 
13. Brazilian Festival of Worcester, Institute Park 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music, amplification system 
• Sunday-September 13, 2026-10:00 a.m. -6:00 p.m. rain date September 20, 2026 
 
Suely DiBara appeared upon behalf of the application. She stated that this is for their annual festival 
and the organization is looking to obtain the entertainment license. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits: Application for one day entertainment license received and dated July 15, 2026.

List of Exhibits:  Application for common victualer license received and dated July 8, 2026. 
 
Alcohol/Entertainment Requests 
 
16. Paku Paku, Inc., 215 Chandler Street 
Request for entertainment license for tv, amplification system, karaoke, DJ 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to postpone the application to the August 6, 2026, 
License Commission meeting.
17. Italian American World War Veterans of the US Inc. Post 3, 14 Itam Court 
Request for change of manager 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to postpone the application to the August 6, 2026, 
License Commission meeting. 
 
18. Worcester Marine Corps League, 181 Lake Avenue 
Request for live music on Sunday from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. outside from  July 26, 
2026 through October 11, 2026- 
 
David from the Marine Corps League appeared upon behalf of the item. He stated that they are 
looking to continue the entertainment they received approval for in the Spring. 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the remaining dates. 
19. Olives Hospitality, LLC, 92 Shrewsbury Street 
• Request for transfer of restaurant all alcohol license from Brick House, LLC dba

• Request for common victualer license 
• Request for entertainment license for tv, radio, dancing by patrons, dancing by 
entertainers, recorded music, live music, amplification system, play, moving picture 
show, floor show, light show, theatrical exhibition, karaoke  
 
Arber Gozhina appeared upon behalf of the applications. He stated that he is looking to transfer the 
licenses from Nuovo. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to approve the transfer of the restaurant all alcohol 
license, common victualer license and entertainment license. 
 
List of Exhibits: 
 
Exhibit A: Application for transfer of restaurant all alcohol license received and dated June 2, 2026. 
Exhibit B: Application for common victualer license received and dated June 2, 2026. 
Exhibit C: Application for entertainment license received and dated June 2, 2026. 
 
20. Grill and Green Kitchen, Inc. 141 Highland Street 
• Request for restaurant all alcohol license

21. L&D Enterprises LLC, 5 Saugus Place,

23. Myron Katz, 667 Main Street
